```{r}
#| label: fig-margin
#| fig-cap: "MPG vs horsepower, colored by transmission."
#| message: false
library(ggplot2)
mtcars2 <- mtcars
mtcars2$am <- factor(mtcars$am, labels = c('automatic', 'manual'))

ggplot(mtcars2, aes(hp, mpg, color = am)) +
  geom_point() + geom_smooth() +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom')
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "World Map Without Australia, Color Indexed."
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(rnaturalearthhires)

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
class(world)

world_without_Australia <- world |> 
  filter(iso_a3 != "AUS")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world_without_Australia,aes(fill = as.factor(mapcolor7)),color = "#401D16", size = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Basic Map of Solomon Islands."
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pacific_groups <- ne_download(scale = 50,type = "admin_0_pacific_groupings")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = pacific_groups)+
  geom_sf(data = world) +
  geom_sf_text(data = world, aes(label = admin))+
  coord_sf(crs = "+proj=ortho +lat_0=0 +lon_0=-160 ") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(145, 175), ylim = c(-20, 5), expand = FALSE) +
  ggtitle("Solomon Islands", subtitle = "Showing Pacific Island Groupings")+
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Interactive Threat Plot"
#| message: false
#| warning: false
 
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)

#load dataset
Malicious_Domains <- read_csv("data/3_malicious_domains.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

#clean column names
Malicious_Domains <- Malicious_Domains |>
  clean_names()

#check column names
names(Malicious_Domains)

#select columns for visualization
threat_votes <- Malicious_Domains |>
  select(domain,
         total_engines,
         threat_severity,
         malicious_votes,
         suspicious_votes,
         harmless_votes,
         undetected_votes)

#check selected columns
View(threat_votes)

#restructure
threat_votes_long <- threat_votes |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(malicious_votes,
                        suspicious_votes,
                        harmless_votes,
                        undetected_votes),
               names_to = "vote_type",
               values_to = "votes")

#check reorganized dataset
View(threat_votes_long)

#establish domain ordering based on malicious votes
domain_order <- Malicious_Domains |>
  arrange(malicious_votes) |>
  pull(domain)

#apply the domain ordering
threat_votes_long <- threat_votes_long |>
  mutate(domain = factor(domain, levels = domain_order))

#create the plot
threat_plot <- ggplot(threat_votes_long, aes(x = domain,
                                             y = votes,
                                             fill = vote_type,
                                             text = paste("Domain:", domain,
                                                          "<br>Vote Type:", vote_type,
                                                          "<br>Votes:", votes,
                                                          "<br>Total Engines:", total_engines,
                                                          "<br>Threat Severity:", threat_severity))) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Threat Detection Votes Across Security Engines",
       subtitle = "Comparison of malicious, suspicious, harmless, and undetected votes",
       x = "Domain",
       y = "Number of Engine Votes",
       fill = "Threat Classification") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90,
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   vjust = 0.5,
                                   size = 7),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                  size = 14))

interactive_threat_plot <- ggplotly(threat_plot, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(hovermode = "closest",
         legend = list(orientation = "h",
                       y = -0.25),
         margin = list(b = 160))

#display interactive visualization
interactive_threat_plot

```
